Possessing all the subtlety and elegance of air itself, the jaathooms of the [Plane of Air](/Planes.aspx?ID=29) operate within dreams, nightmares, and time. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 20 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15 [Jaathoom](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3003) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 157 **Perception** +15; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111); (can't speak any language); cloud of visions **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +14, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +11, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +11, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +9, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +11, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +13, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +9, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +12 **Str** +4 **Dex** +5 **Con** +2 **Int** +2 **Wis** +2 **Cha** +4 **Cloud of Visions** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 60 feet. A jaathoom has [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 60 feet but can only show images, not speak. **Items** [Scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38) --- **AC** 22 **Fort** +9 **Ref** +14 **Will** +11 **HP** 55 **Naturally Invisible** The jaathoom is [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) at all times, though when they take a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) of any kind, they are [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) instead of [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) until the start of their next turn, as the vague outline of their form is faintly visible for a short period of time.
**Turbulent Skies** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527), [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542)) 20 feet. All squares in the emanation are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) for Striding and Flying creatures. Creatures with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527) trait are immune. The jaathoom can activate or deactivate this aura as a single action with the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait. --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 40 feet **Melee** scimitar +15 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 1d6+10 slashing **Melee** fist +16 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 1d4+10 bludgeoning **Ranged** crashing wind +16 ([Air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 1d8+8 bludgeoning **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 21 - **Cantrips (3rd)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66) - **3rd** [Ill Omen](/Spells.aspx?ID=696), [Illusory Creature](/Spells.aspx?ID=158), [Illusory Object](/Spells.aspx?ID=160), [Sleep](/Spells.aspx?ID=288) - **4th** [Nightmare](/Spells.aspx?ID=208), [Vapor Form](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738) - **7th** [Interplanar Teleport](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) (to [Astral Plane](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2832); Elemental Planes; or [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26) only) **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=55)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The jaathoom transforms into a Small or Medium [air elemental](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=408)or aerial [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531), such as an owl. This doesn't affect their statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes. **Hurricane Blast** ([Air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The jaathoom moves all creatures without the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527) trait in their turbulent skies aura 20 feet directly away, clockwise, or counterclockwise. A creature avoids being moved if it succeeds at a DC 21 Fortitude save. **Ominous Dreams** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [Prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=674)) The jaathoom sends a prophetic dream to a sleeping creature within 10 feet. An unwilling creature avoids the vision if it succeeds at a DC 23 Will save. The jaathoom chooses the dream's subject, but not its exact events. The target sees a brief vision of its future related to that subject, with the effect of [_augury_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1445). If the result is bad or mixed, the creature is [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) and can't recover from being frightened until it wakes.
Jaathoom Shuyookhs Jaathoom shuyookhs prefer to manifest wishes informed by their visions of the future. They add the following innate spells: **5th** [_illusory creature_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1567), [_illusory object_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1569), [_nightmare_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1615) (×2), [_sleep_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1675) (×2); **4th** [_ill omen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1566).
